question: What are the top 5 products by net sales?
original_question: What are the top 5 products by net sales?
conversation_history: No previous conversation context (this is the first question).
generated_sql:
SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.category,
    SUM(st.units_sold) AS total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(st.units_sold * st.unit_price * (1.0 - (st.discount_pct / 100.0))), 2) AS net_sales
FROM sales_transactions st
INNER JOIN products p ON st.product_id = p.product_id

GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;
